losses: 1522s Death: Taken at dawn by a Waker on the line at Oldcastle Wreck Yard. At the controls at dawn: Crew 1. Fee 350. Body not recovered.
635s Death: Taken by the Marsh on the roof of car 5 at km 2. Nearest crew: Crew 1, 91 m. Fee 350. Body not recovered.
913s Death: Burned in a blazing car in car 5 at Marrin Yard. Lamp lit since the yard. Fee 350. Body not recovered.
CarLost: Car 5 lost at Drury. Battered and never mended, it came apart; its freight spilled on the line. Inside: the body of Crew 2, the body of Crew 2.
683s Death: Taken by the Marsh on the roof of car 11 at km 2. Nearest crew: Crew 7, 71 m. Fee 350. Body recovered. Refund 262.
